title: Crystal Caverns
survival_class: not stated as one class; per-zone tags (Zone 1 Potentially Safe, Zone 2 Strictly Uninhabitable, Zone 3 Unsafe, Zone 4 Entity Superiority)
physical_identity: A large crystal cave system split into mineral zones: Turquoise (calming), Amethyst (diseased), Ruby (burning hot, red-lit) and an unconfirmed Onyx zone.
scale_topology: Cave tunnels of undetermined extent; Zone 1 15x17 ft cylinders, Zone 2 ~7x5 ft, Zone 3 10x10 ft with 83-degree inclines; Crimson Fortress ~700 ft tall.
anomalies: turquoise calming crystals and detonating used crystals
amethyst wall seals Zone 1 behind entrants
lighting_sound: Zone 1 crystal-lit; Zone 2 dim, fading amethyst glow; Zone 3 thick red glow; Zone 4 almost pitch-black; sound not described.

entities.name: Zone 2 set (Smilers, Deathmoths, Shades, Skin-Stealers, Bone Thieves)
entities.behavior: Shelter in dark grooves; carry diseases

entities.name: Zone 3 additions (Reviooks, Wretches, Nguithr'xurhs, Crawlers, the Disease)
entities.behavior: Roam and chase enraged; turquoise can daze

entities.name: The Entranced
entities.behavior: About 125 passive hive-mind wanderers in Zone 1

entity_policy: SOURCED ENTITIES ONLY: per zone as listed; none confirmed in Zone 1
hazards: unbearable heat and burns in Zone 3
items_communities: M.E.G. Outpost Good Feels (~53 operatives, Zone 1)

entrances.from: Any level where sudden calm is felt
entrances.quote: Enter the darkened doorway, and you will no-clip into Zone 1.
randomly no-clipping through the floor in Level 210

exits.quote: Continuing down the lit path of Zone 1 will lead to Zone 2.
The only way to enter Zone 3 is to go through Zone 2.
rumors of an unlit path in Zone 1 that can lead to Level 108
being able to exit to Level 8

exits.method: unlit tunnel with fluorescent buzz in Zone 3
exits.quote: will send any wanderers back to Level 0
sent to whatever level they wished

signature_mechanic: A progression through mineral zones where calm turquoise leads into sealed, diseased amethyst tunnels and a burning ruby zone, with turquoise as the only counter to enraged entities.
verticality: Second graphite layer ~10 ft below Zone 2; Zone 3 inclines to 83 degrees; Crimson Fortress ~700 ft tall with 1000 ft obsidian bridges.
do_not: let turquoise work on all entities
conflicts_notes: Zone exits contradictory in Zone 3. Page says Zone 4 unconfirmed and released prematurely. Fifth zone is on a separate page. Meditation Cove geode 30 ft radius yet crystal 30 ft tall as written.

key_quotes.quote: expansive crystal cave of undetermined size
a wall of amethyst will slowly grow from the ground and ceiling
Enter the darkened doorway, and you will no-clip into Zone 1.
